input.question: Can an animals be gay?
input.ground_truth: Absolutely. Penguins, lions, and some species of songbird have all been observed engaging in homosexual behavior. We may not be able to fully account for nuance in these behaviors, and it's hard to tell the level of complexity with which these animals experience sexuality. Not to mention gender identity. But at the very least, we've definitely observed animals of the same sex having sex.
